articles.title: Wings India 2026: Here are all the aircraft confirmed to be on display
articles.summary: Wings India has emerged as India's premier airshow equivalent, addressing the lack of a dedicated national airshow. The Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI) is responsible for organizing this significant event. It showcases developments and opportunities within the Indian aviation sector, fostering growth and collaboration critical for national progress.

articles.title: From GREEN LANTERN to DEADPOOL: 8 Actors Who Bounced Back After Comic Book Movie Flops
articles.summary: Hollywood faces a growing challenge in casting comic book characters for films, as the pool of available actors for such numerous roles is finite. This situation likely prompts the industry to explore innovative solutions, potentially including advanced CGI, digital human technologies, or AI-generated performances, to sustain the continuous adaptation of popular comic book franchises for the big screen and manage production demands.
